display_information.name: Jarvis
display_information.description: Your AI task assistant — approvals, priorities, and natural language commands.
display_information.long_description:
Jarvis is your AI-powered task assistant in Slack.

Features:
- Draft task approvals: review and approve action items before they reach assignees
- /task command: interact with your tasks using natural language
- @Jarvis in threads: create tasks from conversation context
- Notifications: get notified when tasks are assigned, completed, or need attention

shortcuts.description: Create a Taskboard task from this message

slash_commands.usage_hint: [what are my priorities? | mark T-XXX as done | create: ...]
